title: 利润冲900亿：奖金创新高，纽约税收压力反成推力？
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: Let's turn to Wall Street, though. Firms are poised to take in $90 billion in profits smashing last year's record. Boneses are also expected to reach in all time high.
segments.zh: 转向华尔街，机构有望实现900亿美元利润，刷新去年纪录。奖金预计也将创历史新高。

segments.en: Joining us now is Herman Chan, senior US bank analyst for Bloomberg Intelligence, who's also gearing up for bank earnings next week. Herman, is this just a really strong first half?
segments.zh: 彭博情报高级美国银行分析师Herman Chan加入我们，他也在为下周银行财报做准备。Herman，这只是一个非常强劲的上半年吗？

segments.en: How much is the second half contributing to what's going to be a banner year for Wall Street?
segments.zh: 下半年对华尔街这个辉煌年份的贡献有多大？

segments.en: Right. The first step was really spectacular, particularly in equity trading.
segments.zh: 对，第一步确实非常惊人，尤其是在权益资产交易方面。

segments.en: And also the resurgence of IPO activity within the group. The second half's turning out to be a bit chopier. We've gotten some mixed guidance from the investor
segments.zh: 还有IPO活动的复苏。下半年变得有些波动。过去一个月左右，我们从市场参与者会议上得到了一些混合指引。

segments.en: conferences over the past month or so where some banks like JP Morgan are expecting continue growth in trading and investment banking, whereas Bank of America seems a bit
segments.zh: 像摩根大通这样的银行预计交易和**银行业务持续增长，而美国银行在交易方面似乎有些波动。

segments.en: chopier results across the trading front. So mixed results expected for the third quarter, and we'll see what it shapes up for the fourth. Herman, is bringing it back to the local level here.
segments.zh: 所以第三季度预计结果混合，我们将看看第四季度如何发展。Herman，回到本地层面。

segments.en: This is a big source of revenue for New York, New York City, the state. Generally, these guys are still prudent staying put here, the talent pools here. Are you seeing anything that
segments.zh: 这是纽约市和纽约州的重要收入来源。一般来说，这些人仍然谨慎地留在这里，人才池在这里。你看到什么让你认为我们可能更多地进入德克萨斯和佛罗里达这样的地方？

segments.en: makes you think that maybe we have more access to this place like Texas and Florida?
segments.zh: 你看到什么让你认为我们可能更多地进入德克萨斯和佛罗里达这样的地方？

segments.en: Yeah, I think you're going to see some more diversification of the footprint for folks in the finance industry. You've seen banks like Morgan Stanley talking about opening up a hub
segments.zh: 是的，我认为你会看到金融行业人士的足迹更加多样化。你已经看到像摩根士丹利这样的银行谈论开设中心。

segments.en: in Dallas, so those things are continued to shape up. I think a lot of it just deals with the tax regime here in New York, whereas a bit more precarious, whereas some tax-friendly or states
segments.zh: 在达拉斯，这些情况持续向好。我认为很大程度上与纽约的税收制度有关，而这里更不稳定，相比之下，一些税收友好的州
